scope: Final production report before planner repair. 75 reported model steps across eight bodies; the contact reward gate uses its recent command-comparison history. This is an online training diagnostic, not a learned self-touch trial.
meaning: The own-body touch reward remains disabled because the actual command did not establish the required advantage over another body's command. Paired physical tests must next measure chosen reachable self-touch.

contact_control.gate_self_why: self-touches: on 2 of the last 32 control moments the bodies' own orders foresaw more of the self-touches that began than another body's order did, and on 2 fewer (with no link to the order the two counts are about equal). The average advantage is 0.8 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is shut.
